::: {.story-formula-card}
$$
\Psi(p,t)=\Phi(p)e^{-ipR}+\Delta\Psi(p,t)
$$

$$
|\Psi|^2
=
|\Phi|^2
+2\,\mathrm{Re}\!\left[\Phi^*(p)e^{ipR}\Delta\Psi(p,t)\right]
+|\Delta\Psi|^2
$$
:::
